components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .btn--primary { color: #fff; background: #256300; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #3f8f01; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 32px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Benefit Lead Card
components.description: Главная карточка преимуществ: иконка слева, заголовок и текст справа.
components.css: .benefit-card--lead { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto; } .benefit-card--lead .benefit-card__icon { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / 3; } .benefit-card--lead .benefit-card__title { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } .benefit-card--lead .benefit-card__text { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; max-width: 65ch; }
